title.zh: 将东明多洛省邦加邦市镇Bongabong中央小学的名称变更为Magdalena Umali Suyon纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Bongabong Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Bongabong, Province of Oriental Mindoro, to Magdalena Umali Suyon Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Bongabong Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Bongabong, Province of Oriental Mindoro, to Magdalena Umali Suyon Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Bongabong Central tại Thị trấn Bongabong, Tỉnh Oriental Mindoro thành Magdalena Umali Suyon Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Bongabong Central ในเทศบาล Bongabong, จังหวัด Oriental Mindoro เป็น Magdalena Umali Suyon Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Bongabong Central di Kotamadya Bongabong, Provinsi Oriental Mindoro menjadi Magdalena Umali Suyon Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Bongabong Central di Perbandaran Bongabong, Wilayah Oriental Mindoro menjadi Magdalena Umali Suyon Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6801_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Bongabong Central Elementary School in the Municipality of Bongabong, Province of Oriental Mindoro, is hereby changed to Magdalena Umali Suyon Memorial School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
